name: Ettin

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and knocked Unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

description: Ettins are two-headed giants whose bickering skulls never quite agree, but whose battleaxe and morningstar strike in the same brutal instant against any who wander into their territory.
